newsitem.title: USA: CSP Inc takes one-time charge of $125,000.
newsitem.headline: CSP Inc takes one-time charge of $125,000.

text.p: CSP Inc (CSPI) said Tuesday that it has consolidated and restructured its operations because its expects fluctuating revenue over the next several quarters, eliminating 14 postions and incurring a one-time restructuring expense of about $125,000.
CSPI said it eliminated the positions, primarily in its manufacturing and Vision Systems operations.
The company said it also consolidated the Embedded Computer and Vision Systems product groups into one organization. These actions, said CSPI, will represent an annual savings of about $1 million.

The company said this action was necessary to reduce operating expenses during the period of transition to CSPI's next generation MAP-1000 and 2000 product lines, which it said will not significantly affect revenues in the current fiscal year, but will begin to ramp up in 1998.
The company reported operating losses of $218,00 and $422,000 in the quarter and six months, respectively, ended Feb 28.
CSPI is a manufacturer of vector processors, which enhance a computer's ability to perform high-speed arithmetic.
